India's GDP growth ran from a 5.8% fall in FY21 to a 9.7% rebound in FY22, then eased to about 6.5% in FY25. These are real growth figures for each fiscal year (April to March), from memory of the official numbers, so they may have been revised since. I haven't included FY26 because I don't have a figure I trust.
